questions.q: A metal wire of length 40 cm is bent into a rectangle of dimensions $x$ by $y$. What value of $x$ maximizes the enclosed area?
questions.answer: $2x + 2y = 40 \Rightarrow y = 20 - x$. Area $A = x(20 - x) = 20x - x^2$. $dA/dx = 20 - 2x = 0 \Rightarrow x = 10$.

questions.q: For what range of values of $x$ is the function $f(x) = x^3 - 6x^2 + 9x - 4$ strictly increasing?
A curve passes through $(1, 4)$ and has gradient function $\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 4x - 1$. Find the equation of the curve.
questions.answer: $y = \int (4x - 1) dx = 2x^2 - x + C$. At $(1, 4)$: $4 = 2(1) - 1 + C \Rightarrow 4 = 1 + C \Rightarrow C = 3$. Curve: $y = 2x^2 - x + 3$.

questions.q: Find the area enclosed by the curve $y = 4 - x^2$ and the $x$-axis.
Find the area of the region bounded by the curve $y = x^2$ and the line $y = 2x$.
questions.answer: Intersections: $x^2 = 2x \Rightarrow x(x - 2) = 0 \Rightarrow x = 0, 2$. Area $= \int_0^2 (2x - x^2) dx = [x^2 - x^3/3]_0^2 = 4 - 8/3 = 4/3$.
